name: orin-whisper-c64
description: Copy of orin-whisper requesting an admission ceiling of 64, for the orin-nano (J3011) / orin-nx (J4012) Whisper concurrency-ceiling sweep (bench/asr_bench/DISPATCH.md). This is a REQUESTED benchmark ceiling only: with voxedge==0.0.13a0, WhisperASRConfig has no max_concurrent field, so the backend clamps the effective admission ceiling to 1 regardless of this value (confirmed in results/concurrency-{orin-nano,orin-nx}-ceiling.md). Same backend/build as orin-whisper (base, bf16 TensorRT encoder, ONNX decoder with KV cache).
